title: Cap Chaos top conveyor — format v1
description: The LAYOUT of the top conveyor (GDD R1–R4, §6.2b), shared by every level that names it (`conveyor` in level.schema.json): the loop's rows, bottles per row, pick zone, drawn shape and where each feeder merges. No bottles — a level supplies those. One file per layout in Assets/CapsChaos/Content/LevelConfig/Conveyors/<id>.json. Structural checks live here; V8 (pick zone, merge points) and V9 (shape) are ConveyorValidator.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension. Convention: <shape>_<rows>_<feeders>f, e.g. oval_16_1f.

rows.description: Rows of belt round the loop. Track position 0 is the first row of the pick zone (the front edge, in front of the slots); positions grow in the direction of travel.

pickRows.description: Rows of the pick zone, track positions 0..pickRows-1. V8: rows ≥ 2 × pickRows + 6.

shape.description: How the loop is drawn (presentation only; the rules never read it). A preset, or a rounded convex polygon: corners [x, z] clockwise seen from above, corner 0 → 1 the front edge (level, lowest, right → left, in front of the slots), each rounded by its radius (V9). Absent = oval.

feeders.description: At most 2 queues that join the loop (R4), a whole queue row at a time: mergeAt is the queue's entrance, and its front row steps onto the free belt row nearest it (within 2 rows either way, outside the pick zone) that is empty on every track it needs. A level gives one bottle queue per feeder, in this order.

mergeAt.description: Track position the feeder joins at. V8: outside the pick zone, one feeder per position.
